{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"For one bag, Gold adds 5 kg to the cabin allowance. You pay $15 for each kilogram over your allowance and nothing if the bag is at or below it."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([cabin, status, route, weight, allowanceResult, feeResult])
$cabin = 0
$gold = 1
$weight = 38
cabin = Control("Cabin", 0, 1, ["Economy", "Business"], $cabin)
status = Control("Gold status", 0, 1, ["No Gold", "Gold"], $gold)
weight = Control("Bag weight (kg)", 10, 40, [], $weight)
base = $cabin == 0 ? 23 : 32
allowance = base + $gold * 5 + $route * 2
excess = $weight > allowance ? $weight - allowance : 0
allowanceResult = Metric("Bag allowance (kg)", allowance)
feeResult = Metric("Single-bag fee ($)", excess * 15)
$route = 0
route = Control("Route", 0, 1, ["Domestic", "International"], $route)","state":[{"name":"cabin","value":0},{"name":"gold","value":1},{"name":"weight","value":38},{"name":"route","value":0}]}]}
